segments.description: Wide establishing shot of a quiet, dimly lit vintage library as a student walks down the stairs [[00:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oYmU8Av_e84&t=2)].
Medium tracking shot of the student entering the main study hall filled with distracted, noisy people [[00:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oYmU8Av_e84&t=10)].
Close-up action shot of students tapping pencils, chewing gum loudly, and rustling papers [[00:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oYmU8Av_e84&t=22)].
Medium close-up shot of the frustrated student struggling to concentrate amidst the escalating background noise [[00:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oYmU8Av_e84&t=35)].
Medium action shot of the student pulling Sony noise-canceling headphones from a bag and putting them on [[00:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oYmU8Av_e84&t=46)].
Wide closing shot revealing the Sony product branding and tagline 'Find your focus' [[00:56](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oYmU8Av_e84&t=56)].
